s: Which Indian city has India proposed as the host for its bid for the 2036 Olympic Games?
x: India's bid for the 2036 Olympics proposes Ahmedabad as the host city.

s:
Consider the following statements about the International Olympic Committee (IOC):
1. It was founded on 23 June 1894 by Pierre de Coubertin.
2. Its headquarters is in Geneva.
3. Kirsty Coventry of Zimbabwe is its first woman President.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
x: The IOC was founded on 23 June 1894 by Pierre de Coubertin and Kirsty Coventry is its first woman President; its headquarters is in Lausanne, not Geneva.

s: Who were India's flag-bearers at the Asian Para Games 2026 held at Aichi-Nagoya?
x: Pramod Bhagat and Simran Sharma were India's flag-bearers; Nishad Kumar and Mona Agarwal carried the flag at the closing ceremony.

s:
Consider the following statements about the Asian Para Games:
1. The first Asian Para Games were held at Guangzhou in 2010.
2. Before 2026, India's best-ever haul was 111 medals at Hangzhou 2022 (held in 2023).
3. The International Paralympic Committee (IPC) was set up in 1992 at Bonn.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
x: The first Asian Para Games were at Guangzhou 2010 and India won a best-ever 111 medals at Hangzhou 2022; the IPC was set up in 1989 at Bonn (1992 is the year of the Paralympic Committee of India).

s: What was India's position in the medal table at the 5th Asian Para Games 2026 at Aichi-Nagoya?
x: India finished fourth with 114 medals (30 gold, 35 silver, 49 bronze), behind China, Japan and Uzbekistan.

s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the 5th Asian Para Games 2026?
o: China topped the medal table with 207 gold medals.
The 6th edition will be held at Hangzhou, China in 2030.
x: The 6th Asian Para Games will be held at Doha, Qatar in 2030; Hangzhou hosted the 4th edition in 2023.

s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched? (Indian athletes at the 5th Asian Para Games 2026 and their sports)
x: Mona Agarwal won two golds in para shooting; Nishad Kumar's golds were in para athletics and Zhang Meng won eight golds in swimming.

s: Which State will host the 8th Khelo India Youth Games from 11 to 22 December 2026?
x: Telangana will host the 8th Khelo India Youth Games 2026 across Hyderabad and five other cities.

s:
Consider the following statements about the 8th Khelo India Youth Games 2026 in Telangana:
1. Rowing is the host sport.
2. Softball is the demonstration sport.
3. Water sports will be held at Hussain Sagar.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
x: Rowing is the host sport and water sports will be at Hussain Sagar; softball is newly introduced, while sailing is the demonstration sport.

s: Who is the co-chair, with Telangana Chief Minister A. Revanth Reddy, of the Organising Committee of the 8th Khelo India Youth Games 2026?
x: Union Sports Minister Mansukh Mandaviya is the co-chair, while CM A. Revanth Reddy chairs the Organising Committee.

s: Which city will host the 2029 Senior World Weightlifting Championships, the first to be held in India?
x: Ahmedabad will host the 2029 Senior Worlds; Moscow will host in 2030 and Ningbo was the venue of the IWF Executive Board meeting.

s:
Consider the following statements about the International Weightlifting Federation (IWF):
1. It was established in 1905 and has its headquarters in Lausanne.
2. Its Executive Board meeting held at Moscow chose India to host the 2029 Senior World Championships.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
x: The IWF was set up in 1905 with HQ at Lausanne; the decision was taken at the Executive Board meeting at Ningbo, China, while Moscow will host the 2030 event.

s: Who were nominated by the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports as athlete representatives on the Organising Committee Board of the 2030 Commonwealth Games, Ahmedabad?
x: Rahul Dravid and Saina Nehwal were nominated as athlete representatives on the 2030 CWG Organising Committee Board.

s:
Consider the following statements about the 2030 Commonwealth Games at Ahmedabad:
1. Its Organising Committee will follow the 2010 Delhi model.
2. It will be the centenary edition of the Games.
3. The first Games were held in 1930 at Hamilton, Canada as the British Empire Games.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
x: The 2030 Games are the centenary edition and the first Games were at Hamilton in 1930; the Organising Committee will be a not-for-profit corporate entity like the 2006 Melbourne model, unlike 2010 Delhi.

s:
Assertion (A): The 2030 Commonwealth Games at Ahmedabad will be the centenary edition of the Games.
Reason (R): The first Commonwealth Games were held in 1930 at Hamilton, Canada as the British Empire Games.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
x: The Games began at Hamilton in 1930, so the 2030 Games mark 100 years; R explains A.

s: In which country were the 2026 U-23 World Wrestling Championships held, where Vishwajit More won silver in men's 55 kg Greco-Roman?
x: Vishwajit More won silver at Las Vegas, USA on 15 October 2026; his earlier bronzes came in Albania (2024) and Serbia (2025).

s:
Consider the following statements:
1. The headquarters of United World Wrestling (UWW) is in Lausanne.
2. Vishwajit More lost the U-23 World Championships 2026 final of men's 55 kg Greco-Roman to Georgia's Koba Karumidze.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
x: More lost the final 12–13 to Koba Karumidze of Georgia; UWW's headquarters is at Corsier-sur-Vevey, Switzerland, not Lausanne.

s: Where were the 2nd World U19 Boxing Championships held from 16 to 27 October 2026?
x: The 2nd World U19 Boxing Championships were held at Budva, Montenegro under World Boxing.

s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched? (Indian medallists at the 2nd World U19 Boxing Championships 2026)
x: Aditya won gold in men's 55 kg; Megha Sheokand won silver (80 kg), Harshika bronze (65 kg) and Prachi Tokas bronze (80+ kg).

s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the 2nd World U19 Boxing Championships 2026?
o: Russia topped the table with 10 medals.
They were held under World Boxing, set up in 2023.
India won four medals, including one gold.
x: India finished joint 7th with Ukraine with 4 medals (1 gold, 1 silver, 2 bronze).

s: In which category did Manisha Bhanwala win gold at the World Wrestling Championships 2026?
x: Manisha Bhanwala beat Abigail Nette of the USA 8–6 in the women's 59 kg freestyle final on 30 October 2026.

s:
Consider the following statements:
1. Manisha Bhanwala is the second Indian World Wrestling champion after Sushil Kumar.
2. Sushil Kumar won his World title in men's 66 kg freestyle at Moscow in 2010.
3. Sakshi Malik won a bronze medal at the London 2012 Olympics.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
x: Manisha is India's second World champion after Sushil Kumar (66 kg, Moscow 2010); Sakshi Malik's Olympic bronze came at Rio 2016, not London 2012.

s: In which city were the World Senior Wrestling Championships 2026 held at Barys Arena?
x: The Championships were held from 24 October to 1 November 2026 at Barys Arena, Astana, Kazakhstan.

s:
Consider the following statements about the World Senior Wrestling Championships 2026:
1. The USA topped the medal table with 15 medals, including 7 gold.
2. Iran was the top team in Greco-Roman.
3. India won four medals, all in women's freestyle.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
x: The USA topped with 15 medals (7 gold), Iran topped Greco-Roman with 192 points, and India won 4 women's freestyle medals.

s: How many medals did India win to top the 46th International Tammer Boxing Tournament at Tampere, Finland?
x: India topped the 46th Tammer Boxing Tournament with 14 medals (4 gold, 2 silver, 8 bronze).

s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched? (Indian boxers at the 46th International Tammer Boxing Tournament)
x: Aarti Dhariyal won gold; Mohammad Hussamuddin and Jasmine won silver, and Vivek Meena won bronze.

s: Pankaj Advani's win at the WBL World Billiards Championship 2026 was his which world title?
x: Pankaj Advani won his 29th world title, aged 41, beating England's Rob Hall 1906–1206.

s:
Arrange the following awards received by Pankaj Advani in chronological order:
1. Padma Shri
2. Arjuna Award
3. Padma Bhushan
4. Khel Ratna
x: Arjuna (2004), Khel Ratna (2006), Padma Shri (2009) and Padma Bhushan (2018).

s: Bodhana Sivanandan became the youngest female International Master at the age of 11 by breaking whose 38-year-old record?
x: Bodhana Sivanandan broke Judit Polgar's 38-year-old record.

s:
Consider the following statements about Bodhana Sivanandan:
1. She is the youngest International Master overall, among both men and women.
2. She beat Norway's Victoria Johansson in the final round of the European Women's Chess Club Cup.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
x: She is the youngest female IM but only the 10th-youngest IM overall, and Victoria Johansson is from Sweden, not Norway.

s: Where is the headquarters of the European Chess Union, which organised the European Chess Club Cup 2026?
x: The European Chess Union was set up in 1985 and has its headquarters in Hunenberg, Switzerland.

s: Which of the following is NOT correct about Indian players at the European Chess Club Cup 2026 at Budva, Montenegro?

Koneru Humpy played for Cercle d'Echecs de Monte-Carlo.
Nihal Sarin and Koneru Humpy won individual gold on Board 1.
Koneru Humpy became India's first female Grandmaster in 2002.
x: Nihal Sarin and Koneru Humpy won individual gold on Board 2, not Board 1.

s: Which team did the Indian women beat 35–15 to win the inaugural Commonwealth Kabaddi Championship?
x: The unbeaten Indian women beat Uganda 35–15; the Indian men beat Sri Lanka 54–20.

s:
Consider the following statements:
1. India's men beat Sri Lanka 54–20 in the final of the inaugural Commonwealth Kabaddi Championship.
2. Kabaddi was a medal sport at the 1990 Beijing Asian Games.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
x: India's men beat Sri Lanka 54–20, and kabaddi became a medal sport at the 1990 Beijing Asian Games.

s: Where was the Hylo Open 2026 (BWF Super 500) held?
x: The Hylo Open was held at Saarlandhalle, Saarbrücken, Germany from 27 October to 1 November 2026.

s:
Consider the following statements about the Hylo Open 2026:
1. P.V. Sindhu beat Norway's Line Kjærsfeldt in the women's singles final.
2. Lakshya Sen beat Indonesia's Jonatan Christie in the men's singles final.
3. The Badminton World Federation (BWF) was set up in 1934 and has its headquarters in Kuala Lumpur.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
x: Lakshya Sen beat Jonatan Christie and the BWF (1934) is based in Kuala Lumpur; Line Kjærsfeldt is from Denmark, not Norway.

s: Which city hosted the Commonwealth Cue Sports Championship 2026 from 7 to 10 October?
x: The Commonwealth Cue Sports Championship 2026 was held at Ahmedabad.

s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Commonwealth Cue Sports Championship 2026?
o: India won the most gold medals.
Heyball was one of its five disciplines.
India topped the table with 13 medals.
Great Britain won four gold medals.

x: The inaugural AIFF U15 Women's Youth League was launched at Belagavi with 16 teams in four groups.

s:
Consider the following statements about the FIFA U-17 Women's World Cup:
1. The 10th edition in Morocco in 2026 has 32 teams.
2. The first edition was held in New Zealand in 2008 and won by North Korea.
3. FIFA was set up on 21 May 1904 and has its headquarters in Zurich.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?

s: Morocco hosts five consecutive editions of the FIFA U-17 Women's World Cup during which period?
x: Morocco hosts five consecutive editions from 2025 to 2029, when the event became annual with 24 teams.

s: Which city hosted the 54th World Artistic Gymnastics Championships from 17 to 25 October 2026?
x: The 54th Championships were held at Rotterdam Ahoy, Netherlands.

s:
Consider the following statements about gymnastics:
1. The FIG, set up in 1881, is the world's oldest international sports federation.
2. The first World Artistic Gymnastics Championships were held at Antwerp in 1903.
3. Women's artistic gymnastics has been part of the Olympics since Amsterdam 1928.

Consider the following statements:
1. Mount Mukut, scaled by an Indian Coast Guard team, is 8,045 m high.
2. The Indian Coast Guard expedition was named "Tat Se Parvat".
3. The Indian Coast Guard plans an Everest expedition in 2027 to mark its Golden Jubilee.

s: Which of the following is NOT correct about Kimi Antonelli, the youngest Formula One World Champion?
o: He won the 2026 Mexico City Grand Prix to clinch the title.
He became champion at the age of 20.
x: Antonelli clinched the title by finishing third at the Mexico City Grand Prix, which was won by Max Verstappen.

s:
Consider the following statements:
1. Lewis Hamilton finished second for Ferrari at the 2026 Mexico City Grand Prix.
2. Before Kimi Antonelli, Sebastian Vettel was the youngest Formula One World Champion, aged 23 in 2010.
3. The first Formula One World Championship in 1950 was won by Giuseppe Farina.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
x: All three are correct: Hamilton (Ferrari) was second at Mexico City, Vettel was 23 in 2010, and Farina won the first championship in 1950.
